candidates.name: Pemphigus
support_spans: intractable mucocutaneous lesions
bullae, erosions, and crusts were present on the lower lip
erosions with epithelized mucosa were observed in the oral cavity
candidates.why: The patient's presentation of intractable mucocutaneous lesions, bullae, erosions, and crusts is consistent with Pemphigus.

candidates.name: Paraneoplastic Pemphigus
support_spans: flaccid discrete and coalesced bullae, crusts, and erosions over erythematous and cicatricial lesions were present on the face, trunk, and extremities
candidates.why: The patient's presentation of flaccid bullae and erosions on the face, trunk, and extremities is consistent with Paraneoplastic Pemphigus.

candidates.name: Pemphigus Vulgaris
support_spans: skin biopsy revealed spongiosis and numerous neutrophils with nuclear dust in the epidermis and superficial perivascular dermatitis with predominant infiltration of lymphocytes in the dermis
candidates.why: The patient's skin biopsy results are consistent with the autoimmune mechanism of Pemphigus Vulgaris.

candidates.name: Paraneoplastic Pemphigus
support_spans: immunoblotting of normal human epidermal extract: Positive for IgG autoantibodies to envoplakin (210 kDa) and periplakin (190 kDa)
candidates.why: The patient's positive immunoblotting results for envoplakin and periplakin are consistent with the paraneoplastic mechanism of Paraneoplastic Pemphigus.
